svg.aria-label: Data flow of the competitor price tracker, table by table. Sources: catalogue.csv loads product; client.yaml loads store; the Open Prices API and the web shop pages load listing and price_observation. listing also reads product and store (the match step), price_observation reads store. Views: daily_price reads listing and price_observation; price_change and price_gap read daily_price and product; undercut reads price_change, product and store; send_alert writes alert_sent from undercut. Readers: the Power BI report reads product, store, daily_price, price_change and price_gap; analysis.ipynb reads all five tables and all four views; the alert email reads undercut. 34 lines, one per table read.
svg.title: Competitor price tracker data flow

g.text: one line per table read · orange table · yellow view · green reader
